resources.name: RouteViews
quotes: To obtain a complete list of prefixes announced in the global routing system, we use routing table (RIB) dumps from a large Route Views collector (route-views4).
Here, we rely on daily snapshots from Route Views [1] and remove any /24 subnet that is not inside an announced prefix as seen by Route Views.
